instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to weave in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Werbs, <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to weafe</lang>, in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: In some cultures, people still weafe their own carpets.
atoms.b: In some cultures, people still ((weave)) their own carpets.

atoms.sound: Last year, my father wove a small carpet as well.
atoms.b: Last year, my father ((wove)) a small carpet as well.

atoms.sound: He had never woven one before.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to breed in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Werbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to breed</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: Usually, ducks breed near our local pond.
atoms.b: Usually, ducks ((breed)) near our local pond.

atoms.sound: Last year, they bred in someone's garden instead.
atoms.b: Last year, they ((bred)) in someone's garden instead.

atoms.sound: All of our neighbours believe that the ducks have never bred elsewhere before.
atoms.b: All of our neighbours believe that the ducks have never ((bred)) elsewhere before.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to lend in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to lend</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: I often lend my best friend a pencil at school.
atoms.b: I often ((lend)) my best friend a pencil at school.

atoms.sound: Earlier today, she lent me one of hers.
atoms.b: Earlier today, she ((lent)) me one of hers.

atoms.sound: Therefore, we have both lent each other pencils now.
atoms.b: Therefore, we have both ((lent)) each other pencils now.
